radiusSource: Radius 1.015 (0.995 to 1.036) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 706,290 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.875 (0.835 to 0.915) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5496 +/- 5.1 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5264749303462961280: teff_gspphot 5495.937 K (16th-84th percentiles 5491.775-5502.065), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5264749303462961280: teff_gspphot 5495.937 K (16th-84th percentiles 5491.775-5502.065), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
